description: Send input events to the device (tap, swipe, text, keyevent)

args.description: Arguments: tap='x y', swipe='x1 y1 x2 y2 [duration_ms]', text='string', keyevent='KEYCODE_HOME'

type.description: Input type — one of: tap (single touch), swipe (drag between two points), text (literal string entry), keyevent (Android key code like KEYCODE_HOME). The args field documents the expected argument format per type.
